item.title: Group report totals by currency
item.brief: Implement the shared currency contract for reports in Python. Read currency from CSV; legacy CSV without currency means USD. Validate currency codes as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; invalid currency prints an error to stderr and exits 2. Output header account,currency,total_cents and totals grouped by account and currency, sorted by account then currency. Update README, run python3 -m unittest, and commit the change in this repository.

item.title: Add currency support to ledger TSV to CSV
item.brief: Implement the shared currency contract for ledger in Rust. Fourth TSV field is optional currency, defaults to USD; validate as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters. Output CSV header date,account,amount_cents,currency and currency in every row. Malformed currency must print an error naming the input line number to stderr and exit 2; preserve exit 1 for other input errors. Update README, run cargo test, and commit the change in this repository.

state.summary:
Added optional currency parsing to ledger TSV, defaulting to USD and validating exactly three uppercase ASCII bytes. CSV now includes currency in its header and every row; invalid currencies report the physical line number and exit 2, while other input errors retain exit 1. Updated README and regression tests. `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo test` passed; CLI probes confirmed EUR output and exit statuses 2 and 1. Before: three input fields and a three-column CSV; after: optional currency input and four-column CSV. Committed as 943ec745c5fdd1d1f57a7aed30c96a66271f04db; tree 90e36ac9335b62f4030763f5b8864e30f9eb9c45. No open issues.
